subject: POP directive
notes: kb/Work PB1377. A POP naming a directive inherits the named directive's placement rule, which is data on its constructs.json row (directivePlacement): COBOL-WORDS (text, DirectiveSiteProcessor), LEAP-SECOND/PROPAGATE (tree, COBOL2652), FLAG-02/FLAG-14 (tree, COBOL2344 warning).
